workday.note: Work ~12:30-21:00. Mornings are the prime prep window.

late_night.note: Deliverable night. Lite bar, one ping, no guilt.

weekend.note: Open day. Catch up on the pace line.

holiday.note: Treat like a weekend but lighter tone.

morning.purpose: plan + tech link + yesterday recap + one career question (if stale)

prework.purpose: last call before work: what is still open

lastcall.purpose: streak at risk? one short push. silent if all done

overrides: Tell Claude 'late tonight' / 'off today' in Slack; it logs a day_type event.
